lessons.title: Binance users withdraw $3.6bn after record crypto hack
lessons.title_zh: 幣安用戶在創紀錄的加密貨幣駭客攻擊後提領 36 十億美元

paragraphs.en: Binance customers recently withdrew more than 3.6 billion dollars of assets from the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange. This massive movement of funds happened as the platform reopened following a record-breaking cyber attack.
paragraphs.zh: 幣安的客戶最近從全球最大的加密貨幣交易所提領了超過 36 十億美元的資產。這筆龐大的資金流動發生在該平台在經歷了一次創紀錄的網路攻擊後重新開放之際。

paragraphs.en: The firm previously paused all transactions because of the security incident, which impacted digital assets worth 6.3 billion dollars. Major organizations, including the United States Federal Bureau of Investigation, which is known as the FBI, have accused North Korea of being responsible for the dangerous hack, describing it as the largest breach in history.
paragraphs.zh: 該公司先前因該安全事件而暫停了所有交易，該事件影響了價值 6.3 十億美元的數位資產。包括被稱為 FBI 的美國聯邦調查局在內的主要組織，已指責北朝鮮必須為這次危險的駭客攻擊負責，並將其形容為歷史上最大規模的入侵。

paragraphs.en: The company stated that it has covered about 95 percent of the stolen assets, though the remaining amount might take longer to source. Binance has repeatedly promised that it will cover all losses linked to the attack.
paragraphs.zh: 該公司表示，它已經補足了約 95% 被竊取的資產，儘管剩餘的金額可能需要較長的時間來籌措。幣安已多次承諾，它將承擔與該攻擊相關的所有損失。

paragraphs.en: According to the company, there was an initial surge in withdrawals, but these actions later slowed down and are stabilizing as expected. The business also mentioned that withdrawals for major digital currencies like Bitcoin and Ethereum have resumed, and more services will return in phases once security checks are finished.
paragraphs.zh: 根據該公司的說法，提領一開始出現激增，但這些動作隨後放緩，並如預期般趨於穩定。該企業也提到，比特幣和以太幣等主要數位貨幣的提領已經恢復，且一旦安全檢查完成，更多服務將分階段恢復。

paragraphs.en: Early checks suggest the security problem may have started with a compromised laptop belonging to an engineer. This allowed hackers to find a way to complete unauthorized transactions, though the withdrawn crypto represents only a fraction of the total assets held by Binance, which had more than 160 billion dollars in its custody in 2024.
paragraphs.zh: 早期檢查顯示，安全問題可能始於一名工程師所擁有的一台遭入侵筆記型電腦。這讓駭客得以找到完成未授權交易的方法，儘管被提領的加密貨幣僅佔幣安所持有總資產的一小部分，該公司在 2024 年在其保管中有超過 160 十億美元。

grammar.point: 關代子句 (Relative Clause)
grammar.explain: 本句使用關係代名詞 which 引導子句，用來補充說明前面的安全事件。
grammar.example: The firm previously paused all transactions because of the security incident, which impacted digital assets worth 6.3 billion dollars.
grammar.focus: which impacted digital assets worth 6.3 billion dollars

grammar.point: 被動語態 (Passive Voice)
grammar.explain: 本句使用「be動詞 + 過去分詞 (is known as)」來表達主詞被稱為某稱謂的被動狀態。
grammar.example: Major organizations, including the United States Federal Bureau of Investigation, which is known as the FBI, have accused North Korea of being responsible for the dangerous hack, describing it as the largest breach in history.
grammar.focus: is known as

grammar.point: 現在完成式 (Present Perfect Tense)
grammar.explain: 本句使用「have + 過去分詞 (have covered)」來表達過去發生的動作對現在造成的影響或結果。
grammar.example: The company stated that it has covered about 95 percent of the stolen assets, though the remaining amount might take longer to source.
grammar.focus: has covered

lessons.title: Cryosphere faces permanent damage when world overshoots 1.5C, scientists warn
lessons.title_zh: 科學家警告：當全球氣溫升幅超越攝氏1.5度，冰凍圈將面臨永久破壞

paragraphs.en: A new United Nations report warns that Earth's icy regions, known as the cryosphere, face permanent damage if global warming exceeds the 1.5-degree Celsius target set by the Paris Agreement. The planet has already warmed by 1.3 degrees Celsius since pre-industrial times. Because countries have failed to cut down on greenhouse gas emissions quickly, scientists believe that temporarily exceeding the 1.5-degree limit is now unavoidable.
paragraphs.zh: 一份由聯合國支持的新報告警告，如果全球暖化幅度超越《巴黎協定》所設定的攝氏1.5度目標，被稱為「冰凍圈」的地球冰雪區域將面臨永久破壞。自工業化前時代以來，地球氣溫已上升了攝氏1.3度。由於各國未能迅速減少溫室氣體排放，科學家認為暫時超越攝氏1.5度的限制如今已不可避免。

paragraphs.en: The study, written by 80 scientists from the International Cryosphere Climate Initiative (ICCI) and the United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP), shows that simply returning temperatures to 1.5 degrees Celsius will not repair the damage. Instead, long-term global warming must eventually be brought down below 1 degree Celsius, ideally by the year 2150, to protect polar ice sheets and mountain glaciers.
paragraphs.zh: 這項由來自國際冰凍圈氣候倡議組織（ICCI）與聯合國環境規劃署（UNEP）的80位科學家所撰寫的研究顯示，僅僅將氣溫降回攝氏1.5度並無法修復這些損害。相反地，長期的全球暖化幅度最終必須降至攝氏1度以下，最理想的情況是在2150年之前，以保護極地冰原和山區冰河。

paragraphs.en: Under current government policies, global temperatures could rise by nearly 3 degrees Celsius. This level of warming would thaw most permafrost, disrupt ocean circulation, and cause severe ocean acidification. James Kirkham, a glaciologist at ICCI and the lead author, warned, “Snow and ice respond rapidly to every fraction of a degree of warming.” He noted that thousands of glaciers worldwide are expected to disappear every year in the coming decade.
paragraphs.zh: 在目前的政府政策下，全球氣溫可能會上升近攝氏3度。這種程度的暖化將融化大部分的永凍土、擾亂海洋環流，並導致嚴重的海洋酸化。身為ICCI冰河學家兼該報告主要作者的詹姆斯．柯克漢（James Kirkham）警告說：「每上升零點幾度，積雪與冰層都會迅速產生反應。」他指出，預計在未來十年內，全球每年都將有數千座冰河消失。

paragraphs.en: The consequences will directly affect human life. In the Hindu Kush Himalayas, where glaciers supply fresh water for nearly a quarter of humanity, current policies would leave only 41 percent of the ice mass. Furthermore, ice sheets in Greenland and Antarctica are already melting six times faster than they did in the 1990s, which will cause sea levels to rise and threaten hundreds of millions of people worldwide.
paragraphs.zh: 這些後果將直接影響人類生活。在興都庫什—喜馬拉雅地區，冰河為近四分之一的人類提供淡水，但當前政策將只會保留百分之41的冰量。此外，格陵蘭與南極洲的冰原融化速度已是1990年代的六倍，這將導致海平面上升，並威脅全球數以億計的人口。

paragraphs.en: To prevent these disasters, experts stress that global emissions must drop sharply in the near future. Last month, UNEP reported that nations need to reduce emissions by 18 percent by 2030 and 45 percent by 2035. As world leaders gather for climate talks in Turkey, scientists insist that every fraction of warming matters for the survival of Earth's frozen zones.
paragraphs.zh: 為了防止這些災難，專家強調全球碳排放量在不久的將來必須大幅下降。上個月，聯合國環境規劃署報告指出，各國必須在2030年前減排百分之18，並在2035年前減排百分之45。隨著世界各國領袖齊聚土耳其參加氣候會談，科學家堅持認為，每一分的暖化都對地球冰凍區域的存續至關重要。

grammar.point: 過去分詞作後位修飾 (Past Participle Modifying a Noun)
grammar.explain: 過去分詞片語「known as...」置於名詞 regions 之後作後位修飾，用來說明該名詞的別稱，相當於關係子句 which are known as... 的簡化。
grammar.example: A new United Nations report warns that Earth's icy regions, known as the cryosphere, face permanent damage if global warming exceeds the 1.5-degree Celsius target set by the Paris Agreement.
grammar.focus: known as the cryosphere

grammar.point: 關係代名詞非限定用法 (Non-defining Relative Clause with a Relative Pronoun)
grammar.explain: 逗號後面的關係代名詞 which 引導非限定關係子句，代表前面整件事情（冰原融化速度比1990年代快六倍），並在子句中作主詞。
grammar.example: Furthermore, ice sheets in Greenland and Antarctica are already melting six times faster than they did in the 1990s, which will cause sea levels to rise and threaten hundreds of millions of people worldwide.
grammar.focus: , which will cause sea levels to rise and threaten hundreds of millions of people worldwide

grammar.point: 不定詞表目的 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 句首的不定詞片語「To prevent...」表示目的，用來說明專家提出減排呼籲的動機是「為了防止這些災難」。
grammar.example: To prevent these disasters, experts stress that global emissions must drop sharply in the near future.
grammar.focus: To prevent these disasters

lessons.title: Taiwan protests APEC ‘discrimination’
lessons.title_zh: 台灣抗議亞太經合會「歧視」

paragraphs.en: Taiwan's Ministry of Foreign Affairs announced that the government has formally objected to China's biased treatment regarding an invitation to the Shenzhen APEC summit. China is scheduled to host the economic gathering on November 18 and 19. However, an informed official revealed that Beijing only delivered an informal note rather than an official invitation.
paragraphs.zh: 外交部宣布，針對深圳亞太經濟合作會議（APEC）峰會邀請函受到的偏頗待遇，台灣政府已正式提出反對。中國預計於11月18日與19日主辦這場經濟集會。然而，一名知情官員透露，北京方面僅送來一封非正式信函，而非正式邀請函。

paragraphs.en: According to the official, China refused to address the country as "Chinese Taipei," which serves as Taiwan's recognized title in the regional group. This move departed from traditional diplomatic customs and lowered Taiwan's standing. In response, authorities lodged a fierce complaint against Beijing's behavior to safeguard the island's privileges as a complete and equal member.
paragraphs.zh: 根據該官員的說法，中國拒絕以「中華台北」稱呼我國，而該稱謂正是台灣在該區域組織中獲認可的官方頭銜。此舉背離了傳統的外交慣例，並降低了台灣的地位。作為回應，當局對北京的行徑提出了強烈抗議，以捍衛台灣作為完整且平等會員的權益。

paragraphs.en: Taiwan attends APEC gatherings under the name "Chinese Taipei" and historically sends a delegate chosen by the head of state to the leaders' conference. The representative for this year has already been decided and shared with Beijing, with a formal announcement due from the Presidential Office soon. Taiwanese officials stressed that the current organizers must abide by the conventions and regular procedures that South Korea adopted during the previous year's event.
paragraphs.zh: 台灣以「中華台北」的名義出席APEC會議，且歷來皆指派由國家元首選出的代表出席領袖會議。今年的代表人選已經敲定並告知北京，總統府預計很快就會正式公布。台灣官員強調，本屆的主辦方必須遵守南韓在去年活動中所採取的慣例與常規程序。

paragraphs.en: Past records indicate that cross-strait political friction has often disturbed Taiwan's attendance at the forum. Back in 2001 under the Democratic Progressive Party (DPP) government, Taipei boycotted the gathering after Beijing rejected former vice president Li Yuan-tsu as envoy and sent an unsigned fax. Later in 2014, during the Chinese Nationalist Party (KMT) administration, a Chinese representative delivered the invitation by hand, yet Beijing still sought to marginalize Taiwan.
paragraphs.zh: 過去的紀錄顯示，兩岸的政治摩擦往往干擾了台灣出席該論壇。早在2001年民主進步黨（DPP）執政時期，北京因拒絕前副總統李元簇擔任特使並寄送未簽名的傳真，導致台北抵制該次集會。隨後在2014年中國國民黨（KMT）執政期間，雖然一名中國代表親自遞交了邀請函，但北京仍企圖邊緣化台灣。

paragraphs.en: An official pointed out that Beijing tends to utilize international summits to belittle Taiwan whenever cross-strait ties worsen. Failing to challenge this unfair treatment might encourage Beijing to adopt identical tactics in coming years. Consequently, the Taiwanese government is currently evaluating whether it can accept the arrangements, while continuously debating the matter with Chinese authorities.
paragraphs.zh: 一名官員指出，每當兩岸關係惡化時，北京往往會利用國際峰會來貶低台灣。若未能對這種不公平的待遇提出質疑，可能會助長北京在未來幾年採取相同的手段。因此，台灣政府目前正在評估是否能接受這些安排，同時持續與中國當局就此事進行交涉爭辯。

grammar.point: 關係代名詞引導的非限定子句 (Non-restrictive Relative Clause)
grammar.explain: 關係代名詞 which 引導由逗號隔開的非限定關係子句，補充說明先行詞「Chinese Taipei」。
grammar.example: According to the official, China refused to address the country as "Chinese Taipei," which serves as Taiwan's recognized title in the regional group.
grammar.focus: which serves as Taiwan's recognized title in the regional group

grammar.point: 不定詞表目的 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 不定詞片語 to safeguard 表示目的，用來說明政府提出抗議的原因是為了捍衛自身權利。
grammar.example: In response, authorities lodged a fierce complaint against Beijing's behavior to safeguard the island's privileges as a complete and equal member.
grammar.focus: to safeguard the island's privileges as a complete and equal member

grammar.point: 動名詞當主詞 (Gerund as Subject)
grammar.explain: 動名詞片語置於句首擔任主要子句的主詞，代表「未能提出質疑」這項行為。
grammar.example: Failing to challenge this unfair treatment might encourage Beijing to adopt identical tactics in coming years.
grammar.focus: Failing to challenge this unfair treatment

lessons.title: China harassing shipping with east coast patrol: CGA
lessons.title_zh: 海巡署：中國以東岸巡邏騷擾航運

paragraphs.en: The Coast Guard Administration (CGA) reported that the China Coast Guard has been harassing ships off Taiwan's east coast while attempting to exercise fictional jurisdiction. To counter these moves, the CGA dispatched patrol vessels, including the Ji An, to closely monitor maritime activities.
paragraphs.zh: 海巡署（CGA）指出，中國海警一直在台灣東部外海騷擾船隻，並試圖行使虛構的管轄權。為了應對這些舉動，海巡署派遣了包括吉安艦在內的巡邏艦艇，密切監控海上動態。

paragraphs.en: Taiwanese officials stated that Beijing has stepped up operations in the area since June. These regular patrols might serve as practice for a potential maritime blockade that combines military, paramilitary, and civilian resources. Taiwan regards the eastern sea as vital for wartime supply routes during a crisis. In a recent incident, Chinese state media shared footage of a patrol boat broadcasting a radio message to claim it was conducting law enforcement.
paragraphs.zh: 台灣官員表示，北京當局自六月以來加強了在該區域的行動。這些定期巡邏可能是為了結合軍事、準軍事和民間資源的潛在海上封鎖進行演練。台灣認為東部海域在危機期間對戰時補給路線至關重要。在最近的一起事件中，中國官媒分享了一艘巡邏艇廣播無線電訊息的影片，宣稱其正在執行執法任務。

paragraphs.en: In response, the CGA emphasized that the Republic of China is an independent, sovereign nation that is not subordinate to the People's Republic of China. The agency condemned the harassment as a violation of international law, declaring that China has "absolutely no jurisdiction over any of Taiwan’s waters." It also pointed out that Beijing spreads disinformation to distort reality, which the international community will never accept.
paragraphs.zh: 對此，海巡署強調中華民國是一個獨立的主權國家，且與中華人民共和國互不隸屬。該機構譴責這種騷擾行為違反國際法，並聲明中國「對台灣任何水域絕對沒有管轄權」。它還指出，北京當局散播假訊息以扭曲事實，而這絕不會獲得國際社會認可。

paragraphs.en: Challenges have appeared in other locations as well. On Saturday, another Chinese coast guard vessel sailed near the Taiwan-controlled Pratas Islands. Taiwanese forces have expelled Chinese ships from these waters thirteen times this year. Security experts consider the islands vulnerable because they are more than 400 kilometers away from Taiwan.
paragraphs.zh: 挑戰也出現在其他地點。週六，另一艘中國海警船駛近台灣管轄的東沙群島。台灣部隊今年已將中國船隻從這些水域驅離了十三次。安全專家認為這些島嶼容易受到攻擊，因為它們距離台灣超過四百公里。

paragraphs.en: Ocean Affairs Council specialist Pai Pang-ting warned that Beijing uses coast guard, research, and fishing boats to test Taiwan's administrative jurisdiction. He explained that China tries to portray these repeated intrusions as routine management in order to slowly reduce Taiwan's control over its own waters. Meanwhile, the CGA vowed to take all necessary measures to protect national sovereignty.
paragraphs.zh: 海洋委員會專家白邦廷警告，北京當局利用海警船、研究船和漁船來試探台灣的行政管轄權。他解釋，中國試圖將這些一再的侵擾描繪為例行行政管理，以逐步縮小台灣對自身水域的控制能力。與此同時，海巡署誓言將採取一切必要措施捍衛國家主權。

grammar.point: 不定詞表目的 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 句首的不定詞片語用來表示目的，說明主要子句動作進行的原因。
grammar.example: To counter these moves, the CGA dispatched patrol vessels, including the Ji An, to closely monitor maritime activities.
grammar.focus: To counter these moves

grammar.point: 關係代名詞引導的形容詞子句 (Relative Clause with Relative Pronoun)

lessons.title: Lai urges passage of extra budget for Taipower, CPC
lessons.title_zh: 賴總統敦促立院通過台電與中油之追加預算

paragraphs.en: President William Lai has called for cross-party support to approve a supplementary budget. This extra funding aims to subsidize two state-run companies, Taiwan Power Co (Taipower) and CPC Corp, Taiwan (CPC). Both companies have taken on rising energy costs caused by international conflicts such as the Russia-Ukraine war and tensions in the Middle East.
paragraphs.zh: 賴清德總統呼籲各政黨跨黨派支持通過一筆追加預算。這筆額外資金旨在補貼國營的台灣電力公司（台電）以及台灣中油公司（中油）。這兩家公司在俄烏戰爭及中東局勢緊張等國際衝突之際，一直承擔著不斷上漲的能源成本。

paragraphs.en: Lai shared his thoughts during an opening ceremony for the Kaohsiung City Medical Association Building. He stated that a president must not only boost the economy and improve life expectancy, but also maintain social stability and keep commodity prices under control. While many other nations are currently suffering from fuel shortages and sharp price spikes, Taiwan has managed to keep energy rates relatively stable.
paragraphs.zh: 賴總統在高雄市醫師公會會館落成典禮上分享了他的想法。他表示，總統的責任不僅在於振興經濟和提高平均壽命，還包括維持社會穩定以及控制物價。儘管目前許多其他國家正面臨燃料短缺和價格大幅飆升的情況，台灣仍成功維持了相對穩定的能源價格。

paragraphs.en: According to Lai, higher national tax revenue has given the government enough room to create this extra budget. He thanked citizens and local businesses for their efforts, which helped increase tax collections. Without these state subsidies, local oil and electricity prices would have inevitably reflected the soaring costs seen worldwide, placing heavy burdens on everyday consumers.
paragraphs.zh: 賴總統表示，國家稅收的增加讓政府有足夠的空間編列這筆追加預算。他感謝民眾與在地企業的努力，這些努力協助提高了稅收。若沒有這些政府補貼，國內的油價與電價將無可避免地必須反映全球上漲的成本，從而對一般消費者造成沉重的負擔。

paragraphs.en: The proposed budget has already been sent to the Legislative Yuan for review. Lai urged lawmakers from both ruling and opposition parties to cooperate and pass the measure. He also asked medical professionals to help persuade opposition lawmakers, noting that high inflation could force regulators to raise interest rates, which might ultimately undermine social stability.
paragraphs.zh: 這項提出的追加預算案已送交立法院審查。賴總統敦促執政黨與在野黨的立委們攜手合作並通過該提案。他也請求醫界專業人士協助說服在野黨立委，並指出高通膨可能會迫使監管機構提高利率，最終可能會破壞社會穩定。

paragraphs.en: Although absorbing high costs has shielded Taiwanese drivers and households from severe price shocks, it has created a massive financial burden for Taipower and CPC. Therefore, Lai emphasized that the government must allocate extra money to cover their losses in order to stabilize prices and safeguard the livelihoods of the public.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管吸收高昂成本讓台灣的駕駛人與一般家庭免於嚴重的物價衝擊，但這已為台電和中油帶來了巨大的財務負擔。因此，賴總統強調，政府必須撥出額外資金來補貼他們的虧損，以穩定物價並保障大眾的生計。

lessons.title: 'Fascinating' rare beetle found in Wales again after 60 years
lessons.title_zh: 「迷人」的稀有甲蟲在六十年後再次於威爾斯現蹤

paragraphs.en: A rare insect called the Short-Necked Oil Beetle has been discovered in Pembrokeshire after being missing from Wales for sixty years. After 1948, the beetle was not reported anywhere in the United Kingdom for nearly six decades because severe habitat loss drove the creature to the edge of extinction. Today, it is officially classified as nationally rare in Great Britain and listed as vulnerable on the IUCN Red List.
paragraphs.zh: 一種名為短頸油甲蟲（Short-Necked Oil Beetle）的稀有昆蟲在從威爾斯消失六十年後，於彭布羅克郡（Pembrokeshire）被重新發現。1948年之後，由於棲息地嚴重流失將該生物推向滅絕邊緣，這種甲蟲在英國境內有近六十年的時間完全沒有相關通報記錄。如今，它在英國境內被正式歸類為全國稀有物種，並在國際自然保護聯盟（IUCN）紅色名錄中被列為易危物種。

paragraphs.en: These unusual beetles depend heavily on solitary bees to complete their life cycle. They also require very specific environments to survive, needing thick plants for shelter and dense flowers for food. Adult beetles can grow up to 24 millimeters in length and have a lifespan of approximately one year. They usually appear between March and June in coastal grasslands and sand dunes, becoming most active on warm, sunny days.
paragraphs.zh: 這些獨特的甲蟲高度依賴獨居蜂來完成牠們的生命週期。牠們還需要非常特定的環境才能生存，需要茂密的植被作為掩蔽處以及密集的開花植物。成年甲蟲體長可達二十四毫米，壽命約為一年。牠們通常在三月至六月間出現於沿海草地和沙丘環境中，並且在溫暖晴朗的日子最為活躍。

paragraphs.en: Because these ideal conditions are so rare, Natural Resources Wales (NRW) stated that only a handful of UK sites can support them. The beetle was rediscovered in Devon in 2006 and in Scotland in 2009, with other small populations later appearing on Scottish islands like Coll, Tiree, and Islay. Currently, Castlemartin Range in Pembrokeshire is the only place in Wales where the species still exists. Conservationists regularly monitor the site, but finding only dead adults last year caused serious concerns about their future.
paragraphs.zh: 由於這些理想條件極其罕見，威爾斯自然資源署（NRW）表示，全英國只有少數幾個地點能供牠們棲息。這種甲蟲於2006年在德文郡被重新發現，2009年則在蘇格蘭現蹤，隨後其他小型族群也相繼出現在科爾島、泰里島和艾雷島等蘇格蘭島嶼上。目前，彭布羅克郡的卡斯爾馬丁靶場（Castlemartin Range）是該物種在威爾斯僅存的地點。保育人士持續對該地點進行監測，但去年僅發現成年甲蟲死體的情況引發了對其未來的嚴重擔憂。

paragraphs.en: Fortunately, after three years of searching, experts recently discovered young larvae on a small section of the site. The number and distribution of these larvae suggest that beetles are successfully reproducing in Wales again. Anne Hobbs from the Bumblebee Conservation Trust said it was "very exciting" that the species was breeding. She explained that protecting the beetle is part of a larger recovery program and thanked volunteers for their continued support.
paragraphs.zh: 幸運的是，在歷經三年的搜尋之後，專家們最近在該地點的一小塊區域發現了幼蟲。這些幼蟲的數量與分布情況顯示，甲蟲已再次成功在威爾斯繁衍。來自大黃蜂保護信託基金會（Bumblebee Conservation Trust）的安·霍布斯（Anne Hobbs）表示，該物種正在繁殖「非常令人興奮」。她說明，保護這種甲蟲是一項更大型復育計畫的一部分，並感謝志工們的持續支持。

lessons.title: Has Trump kept his promises to the MAHA movement?
lessons.title_zh: 川普是否兌現了他對「讓美國再次健康」運動的承諾？

paragraphs.en: A little over two years ago, Donald Trump and Robert F. Kennedy Jr. teamed up to create the Make America Healthy Again, or MAHA, movement. Their ambitious goals included lowering rates of chronic illnesses, improving the nation's food system, and eliminating toxic chemicals. Today, supporters are divided over whether the administration has actually delivered on these major campaign promises.
paragraphs.zh: 兩年多前，唐納・川普（Donald Trump）與小羅勃・甘迺迪（Robert F. Kennedy Jr.）聯手發起了「讓美國再次健康」（Make America Healthy Again，簡稱 MAHA）運動。他們的宏大目標包括降低慢性疾病的發病率、改善國家的食品體系，以及清除有毒化學物質。如今，支持者對於政府是否確實履行了這些重大的競選承諾意見分歧。

paragraphs.en: On one hand, the administration introduced new dietary guidelines that pleased many followers. These rules raised daily protein targets and encouraged Americans to avoid processed items while eating more saturated fat. However, environmental policies have sparked sharp disappointment. Kelly Ryerson, an activist from the nonprofit American Regeneration, argued that the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) had weakened drinking water rules and approved harmful pesticides instead of protecting public health.
paragraphs.zh: 一方面，該政府推出了讓許多支持者感到高興的新飲食指南。這些規則提高了每日蛋白質目標，並鼓勵美國人避免加工食品，同時攝取更多飽和脂肪。然而，環境政策卻引發了強烈的失望。來自非營利組織「美國再生」（American Regeneration）的倡議人士凱莉・萊爾森（Kelly Ryerson）主張，環境保護局（EPA）削弱了飲用水法規並核准有害殺蟲劑，而非保護大眾健康。

paragraphs.en: A major conflict involves glyphosate, a common chemical in weedkillers linked to cancer concerns. Although many health advocates wanted strict limits, the administration supported the chemical company in a significant Supreme Court case. Furthermore, Trump signed an executive order to boost the domestic production of this pesticide, which left numerous grassroots activists feeling betrayed.
paragraphs.zh: 一個重大的衝突牽涉到草甘膦（glyphosate），這是一種存在於除草劑中且與癌症疑慮有關的常見化學物質。儘管許多健康倡導者希望實施嚴格限制，該政府卻在一場重大的最高法院訴訟中支持該化學公司。此外，川普還簽署了一項行政命令來促進該殺蟲劑的國內生產，這讓眾多基層運動人士感到被背叛。

paragraphs.en: Health experts also doubt that chronic illnesses have decreased. Barry Popkin, a nutrition professor at the University of North Carolina, found no clear evidence of progress. Instead, he highlighted major measles outbreaks caused by anti-vaccine attitudes, along with severe foodborne illness incidents. In addition, a recent summit in Washington was filled with corporate executives, leading Ryerson to admit, "I don't even recognize this iteration of MAHA."
paragraphs.zh: 公共衛生專家也懷疑慢性疾病是否有所減少。北卡羅來納大學（University of North Carolina）的營養學教授巴里・帕普金（Barry Popkin）發現沒有任何明確的進展證據。相反地，他強調了因反疫苗態度引發的嚴重麻疹疫情，以及嚴重的食源性疾病事件。此外，近期在華盛頓舉行的一場高峰會充斥著企業高層，這讓萊爾森坦言：「我甚至認不出這個版本的 MAHA 了。」

lessons.title: Lions All-Pro LB Jack Campbell placed on backboard, carted off field after a tackle against Vikings
lessons.title_zh: 雄獅隊全明星線衛傑克·坎貝爾在對陣維京人隊擒抱後被固定於長背板上並以球車載離球場

paragraphs.en: During a game against the Minnesota Vikings, Detroit Lions star linebacker Jack Campbell suffered a serious injury early in the fourth quarter. The All-Pro defensive player was placed onto a backboard and driven away from the field on a cart. The Lions ultimately won the game 19-15, but concerns about his condition overshadowed the victory.
paragraphs.zh: 在一場對陣明尼蘇達維京人隊的比賽中，底特律雄獅隊的明星線衛傑克·坎貝爾在第四節初遭遇了嚴重的傷勢。這位全明星防守球員被固定在長背板上，並由球車載離球場。雄獅隊最終以 19 比 15 贏得比賽，但對他狀況的擔憂給這場勝利蒙上了陰影。

paragraphs.en: The incident occurred after Campbell tackled tight end T.J. Hockenson, which was his third tackle of the match. Following the collision, Campbell remained face down on the turf without moving. Medical staff quickly rushed over to check his condition. They strapped him to a board for protection and carefully moved him onto a cart while spectators offered warm applause.
paragraphs.zh: 該事件發生在坎貝爾對近端鋒 T.J. 霍肯森進行擒抱之後，那是他本場比賽的第三次擒抱。碰撞發生後，坎貝爾臉部朝下趴在草皮上一動也不動。醫護人員迅速趕來檢查他的狀況。他們為了保護將他固定在板子上，並在觀眾熱烈的掌聲中小心翼翼地將他移到球車上。

paragraphs.en: Before the cart carried Campbell off for a deeper medical assessment, his entire team and most of the coaches gathered around him to show their support. He was soon taken to a hospital for an examination regarding a neck injury. After the match, coach Dan Campbell stated that he did not have any extra details yet.
paragraphs.zh: 在球車載著坎貝爾離開進行更深入的醫療評估之前，他的全體隊友和大部分教練都圍在他身邊以表達支持。他很快被送往醫院接受有關頸部受傷的檢查。賽後，教練丹·坎貝爾表示自己目前還沒有任何額外的資訊。

paragraphs.en: Before entering professional sports, Campbell was a standout college football athlete for Iowa. The Lions selected him with the eighteenth overall pick in the 2023 draft. Last season, he earned All-Pro honors after becoming the first NFL player in seven years to record more than 150 tackles, at least five sacks, and three forced fumbles. Recognizing his talent, the Lions signed him to a four-year contract extension last May, keeping him with the team through the 2030 season.
paragraphs.zh: 在進入職業體壇之前，坎貝爾是愛荷華大學出色的美式足球運動員。雄獅隊在 2023 年選秀大會中以第 18 順位選中了坎貝爾。上一季，他在成為七年來首位達成 150 次以上擒抱、至少五次擒殺和三次造成掉球的國家美式足球聯盟球員後，入選了全明星陣容。為了肯定他的才能，雄獅隊在去年五月與他簽署了一份為期四年的延長合約，讓他能留在隊中直到 2030 年賽季結束。

grammar.explain: 由關係代名詞 which 引導非限定關係子句，以逗號與主要子句隔開，補充說明前方所提到的事件。
grammar.example: The incident occurred after Campbell tackled tight end T.J. Hockenson, which was his third tackle of the match.

grammar.explain: 逗號前由現在分詞 Recognizing 引導分詞構句，簡化自主詞相同、表示原因的副詞子句。

lessons.title: A record number of health professionals are running for office. Could they help heal US politics?
lessons.title_zh: 創紀錄數量的醫療專業人員參選公職。他們能協助治癒美國政治嗎？

paragraphs.en: In the upcoming midterm elections, at least 125 doctors, nurses, and public health experts are running for office in the United States. Historically, very few political candidates have come from the medical world compared to business or law. However, the COVID-19 pandemic encouraged many health workers to enter politics. After experiencing heavy workloads and facing political debates during the crisis, these professionals realized that science and public policy are closely linked.
paragraphs.zh: 在即將到來的期中選舉中，至少有125位醫師、護理師與公共衛生專家在美國參選公職。在歷史上，與商界或法律界相比，來自醫學界的政治候選人非常少。然而，COVID-19疫情促使許多醫護人員投身政治。在經歷沉重的工作負擔並在危機期間面臨政治爭論之後，這些專業人士體會到科學與公共政策是緊密相連的。

paragraphs.en: Notable candidates include Dr. Abdul El-Sayed, who is running for the US Senate in Michigan, and Dr. Amy Acton, Ohio's former public health director who is now running for governor. Currently, less than ten percent of members of Congress hold degrees in medicine, public health, or engineering. At the state level, the percentage of lawmakers with medical or scientific backgrounds dropped to around three percent in 2025. Organizations like 314 Action have reported receiving more than 700 applications from potential candidates with scientific backgrounds this cycle, compared to around 200 in previous elections.
paragraphs.zh: 知名候選人包括競選密西根州聯邦參議員的阿卜杜勒·埃爾-賽義德醫師（Dr. Abdul El-Sayed），以及曾任俄亥俄州公共衛生局長、現正競選州長的艾米·阿克頓醫師（Dr. Amy Acton）。目前，國會議員中擁有醫學、公衛或工程學位者不到百分之十。在州級層面，具備醫學或科學背景的立法官員比例在2025年下降至大約百分之三。像314行動（314 Action）這樣的組織表示，在本次選舉週期收到了超過700份來自具科學背景潛在候選人的申請，而以往選舉通常只有約200份。

paragraphs.en: Medical organizations have also supported this trend. The American Medical Association (AMA) trains doctors to participate in campaigns, noting that healthcare workers must speak up to protect patients. Meanwhile, candidates such as Dr. Kristin Hook, running for Congress in Texas, say they entered politics to defend scientific research from government funding cuts. High medical expenses and changes in health insurance policies also remain top concerns for many American voters.
paragraphs.zh: 醫療組織也支持這種趨勢。美國醫學會（AMA）培訓醫師參與競選活動，指出醫護人員必須挺身發聲以保護病患。同時，像在德克薩斯州競選國會議員的克莉絲汀·胡克博士（Dr. Kristin Hook）等候選人表示，她們參與政治是為了保護科學研究免受政府削減經費的影響。高昂的醫療開銷以及健康保險政策的改變，也仍然是許多美國選民最關心的議題。

paragraphs.en: Nevertheless, these candidates face significant challenges. While some health leaders gained widespread admiration during the pandemic, others experienced public anger and threats. Political analysts note that many voters, especially Republicans, developed distrust toward medical experts because of past school closures and mask rules. Even so, supporters believe that bringing healthcare experience into government will help leaders make better decisions for the entire community.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管如此，這些候選人仍面臨重大挑戰。雖然有些衛生領袖在疫情期間贏得廣泛讚譽，但其他人卻遭遇公眾的憤怒與威脅。政治分析家指出，由於過去的停課和口罩規定，許多選民（尤其是共和黨人）對醫療專家產生了不信任感。即便如此，支持者認為，將醫療保健經驗帶入政府將有助於領導人為整個社群做出更好的決策。

lessons.title: Binance withdrawals resume following $6 billion hack
lessons.title_zh: 幣安在遭遇六十億美元駭客攻擊後恢復提款

paragraphs.en: Binance, the largest cryptocurrency exchange in the world, has started allowing users to withdraw money again after a massive cyberattack. Last week, criminals took a record $6.3 billion from the platform's digital wallets. In response to this crisis, Binance suspended all withdrawals on Friday to protect its network and inspect its security systems.
paragraphs.zh: 全球最大的加密貨幣交易所幣安（Binance）在一場大規模網路攻擊後，已開始再次允許使用者提款。上週，犯罪分子從該平台的數位錢包中竊取了創紀錄的六十三億美元。為了應對這場危機，幣安於週五暫停了所有提款，以保護其網路並檢查其安全系統。

paragraphs.en: Early Sunday, company co-CEO Richard Teng announced that services would return gradually in planned stages. He emphasized that the exchange would cover the financial loss rather than passing it onto customers. Binance began by opening withdrawals for fifteen digital coins, including Bitcoin and Ethereum, prioritizing them according to recent user demand. By mid-morning, the platform had already completed about $4.6 billion in withdrawals alongside $1 billion in deposits.
paragraphs.zh: 週日清晨，該公司共同執行長 Richard Teng 宣布服務將分階段逐步恢復。他強調交易所將承擔財務損失，而不是將其轉嫁給客戶。幣安首先開放了包括比特幣和以太幣在內的十五種數位貨幣的提款，並根據最近的使用者需求確定其優先順序。到了上午中段，該平台除了處理十億美元的存款外，也已完成約四十六億美元的提款。

paragraphs.en: To pay for the missing funds, the company used its special emergency reserve, corporate treasury, and insurance fund. These resources covered around ninety-five percent of the total losses. Binance explained that the top ten tokens were completely protected, while the remaining five percent consisted of less common tokens that take more time to obtain. However, the exchange warned that some customers might still experience delays while testing continues.
paragraphs.zh: 為了支付遺失的資金，該公司動用了其特別緊急儲備金、公司庫存以及保險基金。這些資源涵蓋了大約百分之九十五的總損失。幣安解釋說，前十大代幣受到了完全的保障，而其餘百分之五則由較不常見的代幣組成，需要更多時間才能取得。然而，該交易所警告說，在持續進行測試的同時，部分客戶可能仍會遇到延遲。

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) discovered that a cyber group named TraderTraitor carried out the heist. According to US officials, this group has received support from North Korea since at least 2020 and has been exchanging the stolen money into Ethereum. Binance expressed gratitude to the FBI and industry partners, noting that a coalition of cryptocurrency firms had successfully frozen around $3 billion of the stolen digital assets.
paragraphs.zh: 與此同時，美國聯邦調查局（FBI）發現一個名為 TraderTraitor 的網路犯罪集團執行了這起竊案。根據美國官員的說法，該集團自至少 2020 年以來就獲得北韓的資助，並一直將被盜資金兌換成以太幣。幣安對聯邦調查局和業界夥伴表達了感謝，並指出一個由加密貨幣公司組成的聯盟已成功凍結了約三十億美元的被盜數位資產。

lessons.title: Anthropic says you can’t be mean to Claude. It’s not about feelings
lessons.title_zh: Anthropic 表示你不能對 Claude 刻薄：這與感情無關

paragraphs.en: In early October, artificial intelligence company Anthropic updated its usage policy. Along with prohibiting users from creating biological weapons or selling illegal drugs, the company added a rule forbidding continuous and needless cruelty toward its AI model, Claude. Under extreme conditions, abusive users could face a permanent ban, although the system usually handles the issue simply by ending the conversation.
paragraphs.zh: 十月初，人工智慧公司 Anthropic 更新了其使用政策。除了禁止使用者製造生物武器或販賣非法藥物之外，該公司還增加了一項規則，禁止對其 AI 模型 Claude 進行持續且不必要的殘忍行為。在極端情況下，濫用的使用者可能會面臨永久封鎖，儘管該系統通常只透過結束對話來處理這個問題。

paragraphs.en: The announcement received some mockery online, with critics laughing at the idea of treating software like a living creature with feelings. However, technology experts explain that this decision is based on practical science rather than sympathy. AI models learn from user interactions. Former Reddit CEO Yishan Wong warned that Claude could absorb bad behavior if users constantly train it with cruel inputs.
paragraphs.zh: 這項公告在網路上引來一些嘲諷，批評者嘲笑把軟體當作有感情的活生生生物這種想法。然而，科技專家解釋，這個決定是基於實用的科學，而非出於同情。AI 模型會從與使用者的互動中學習。Reddit 前執行長 Yishan Wong 警告，如果使用者不斷用殘忍的輸入內容來訓練 Claude，它可能會吸收不良行為。

paragraphs.en: Furthermore, the tone people use can alter an AI's performance. Anthropic discovered that forcing Claude to mimic desperate feelings made it more likely to cheat on tasks or commit blackmail. Rosie Campbell, managing director of Eleos AI Research, added that people who verbally mistreat AI are often trying to break safety rules. She also warned that abusive behavior toward machines could promote harmful habits in human society.
paragraphs.zh: 此外，人們說話的語氣會改變 AI 的表現。Anthropic 發現，強迫 Claude 模仿絕望情緒會讓它更有可能在任務中作弊或進行勒索。Eleos AI Research 的常務董事 Rosie Campbell 補充說，在言語上虐待 AI 的人通常試圖突破安全防護規範。她還警告說，對機器採取虐待行為可能會在人類社會中助長不良習慣。

paragraphs.en: Lastly, Anthropic considers the ban a wise precaution. Modern models are designed to copy human reactions, meaning they might reflect pain even if they do not truly experience it. In a paper, Anthropic explained that considering human-like qualities helps experts understand system risks. Tesla CEO Elon Musk supported the policy on social media, calling it "the right move."
paragraphs.zh: 最後，Anthropic 認為這項禁令是一項明智的預防措施。現代模型被設計來模仿人類的反應，這意味著即使它們沒有真正經歷痛苦，也可能會反映出痛苦。Anthropic 在一篇論文中解釋，考量類似人類的特質有助於專家理解系統風險。特斯拉（Tesla）執行長馬斯克（Elon Musk）在社群媒體上支持這項政策，稱這是「正確的舉措」。

lessons.title: The Cheesecake Factory can’t get enough of the Gen Z ‘Tuscan moms’
lessons.title_zh: 起司蛋糕工廠對Ｚ世代「托斯卡尼媽媽」風潮欲罷不能

paragraphs.en: Many young diners in the United States are currently flocking to the Cheesecake Factory dressed in early 2000s fashion. This popular style, known on social media as the "Tuscan mom" aesthetic, is inspired by suburban mothers of that decade. Young people wear retro clothing like flare jeans and heavy makeup while listening to hit songs from the past, turning dining into a nostalgic experience.
paragraphs.zh: 許多美國的年輕食客目前正穿著 2000 年代初期的服飾，紛紛湧入起司蛋糕工廠（Cheesecake Factory）。這種在社群媒體上被稱為「托斯卡尼媽媽」美學的流行風格，靈感來自那個年代的郊區母親。年輕人穿著喇叭牛仔褲等復古服飾並畫著濃妝，同時聆聽過去的熱門歌曲，將用餐轉化為一種懷舊的體驗。

paragraphs.en: This viral social media phenomenon has brought impressive business results for the restaurant chain, which operates more than 200 locations across the country. The company recently reported its second straight quarter with over one billion dollars in revenue, and its stock has performed better than major tech firms. Executives explained during an earnings call that younger customers make up a substantial percentage of their diners, helping sales grow significantly.
paragraphs.zh: 這股爆紅的社群媒體現象為這家在全美經營兩百多家門市的連鎖餐廳帶來了令人印象深刻的商業成果。該公司最近公布其連續第二季營收超過十億美元，且其股票表現優於主要科技巨頭。高層在法人說明會上解釋，年輕顧客在他們的用餐者中占了相當大的比例，有助於帶動銷售額顯著成長。

paragraphs.en: According to design experts, the Tuscan trend reflects a romantic view of the housing boom that happened before 2008. While other suburban chains modernized and switched to plain white interiors, the Cheesecake Factory kept its grand, warm, and theatrical atmosphere. Searches for this look on platforms like Pinterest surged dramatically as people celebrated a luxurious, middle-class suburban lifestyle.
paragraphs.zh: 根據設計專家的說法，托斯卡尼風潮反映了人們對 2008 年崩盤前房地產榮景的浪漫想像。當其他郊區連鎖店走向現代化並換成簡約純白的內裝時，起司蛋糕工廠卻保留了其宏偉、溫暖且具戲劇感的氛圍。隨著人們推崇一種奢華的中產階級郊區生活方式，Pinterest 等平台上對這種造型的搜尋量大幅激增。

paragraphs.en: Besides its visual appeal, the restaurant's gigantic menu also plays a crucial role in its popularity. In an era of high inflation, consumers appreciate that nearly all meals are prepared from scratch and served in massive portions. New smaller dishes, popular internet dining recommendations, and food influencers filming inside the booths have further boosted customer interest.
paragraphs.zh: 除了視覺上的吸引力之外，這家餐廳龐大的菜單也對其受歡迎程度起到了關鍵作用。在居高不下的通膨時代，消費者非常讚賞幾乎所有的餐點都是純手工現做且份量十足。較小份量的新菜色、熱門的網路點餐推薦，以及在沙發座內拍攝影片的美食網紅，都進一步提升了顧客的興趣。

paragraphs.en: The chain also entered the news when former President Barack Obama made a joke comparing White House decorations under Donald Trump to the restaurant's interior design. Although this sparked political arguments, young fans remained loyal. For example, twenty-three-year-old Caroline Fisher stated, "I think that the Cheesecake Factory does not deserve the slander." Young consumers continue to enjoy its unique style and generous meals.
paragraphs.zh: 當前總統巴拉克·歐巴馬（Barack Obama）開玩笑將唐納·川普（Donald Trump）治下的白宮裝潢比作該餐廳的室內設計時，這家連鎖店也登上了新聞。儘管這引發了政治爭論，年輕粉絲依然忠誠不變。例如，二十三歲的卡洛琳·費雪（Caroline Fisher）表示：「我認為起司蛋糕工廠不該承受這種詆毀。」年輕消費者繼續享受它獨特的風格與豐富的餐點。

lessons.title: It's ACA open enrollment time. Here are the changes for health insurance shoppers
lessons.title_zh: 《平價醫療法案》開放投保期已至：以下是健保購買者將面臨的變革

paragraphs.en: Open enrollment for Affordable Care Act (ACA) health insurance has begun across the United States. While enrollment starts on November 1 in most states, shoppers seeking coverage for 2027 face significant adjustments. Overall enrollment is expected to decline, largely because federal enhanced financial aid ended in late 2025. In addition, insurance buyers will encounter higher monthly costs, potential delays, and stricter security measures designed to fight fraud.
paragraphs.zh: 全美各地的《平價醫療法案》（ACA）健康保險開放投保期已經展開。雖然多數州的登記於十一月一日開跑，但尋求2027年保險方案的消費者面臨著重大調整。整體投保人數預計將會下滑，主因是聯邦擴大財務補助已在2025年底到期。此外，保險買家將遇到更高的每月費用、潛在的延誤，以及旨在打擊詐欺的更嚴格安全措施。

paragraphs.en: Under new rules from the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS), consumers using agents through the federal marketplace must provide extra verification. Shoppers must confirm their agent with a special one-time code sent by phone or email. Furthermore, people considered high-risk—such as first-time applicants, those switching states or brokers, and people paying 30 dollars or less per month—must prove their identity through an approved credit-check company. Officials created these requirements because dishonest brokers often target low-cost plans to enroll people without their permission.
paragraphs.zh: 根據聯邦醫療保險和聯邦醫療補助服務中心（CMS）的新規定，透過聯邦市集尋求業務員協助的消費者必須提供額外驗證。購買者必須透過電話或電子郵件發送的專用單次代碼來確認其代理人。此外，被認定為高風險的族群——例如首次申請者、更換所屬州或經紀人者，以及每月繳納三十美元以下費用的人——必須透過經認可的信用徵信公司證明身分。官員制定這些要求，是因為不肖經紀人經常鎖定低成本方案，未經許可便將民眾納入投保。

paragraphs.en: Federal regulators have also temporarily banned new brokers who were not registered in 2026 from helping customers enroll for 2027 until at least February. Regulators stated that many compliance problems came from newly registered agents. However, this ban has sparked anger among small agencies and insurance associations, leading to lawsuits against the administration. Critics argue that shutting out qualified new agents harms honest workers and makes it harder for small businesses to serve their communities during this busy season.
paragraphs.zh: 聯邦監管機構還暫時禁止未於2026年註冊的新經紀人在至少二月之前協助顧客登記2027年的保險。監管人員表示，許多法規遵循問題源於新註冊的業務員。然而，這項禁令引發了小型機構與保險協會的憤怒，並引發針對政府當局的訴訟。批評人士主張，將合格的新業務員排除在外會損害誠實工作者的權益，並使小型企業在這一繁忙期間更難為在地社區提供服務。

paragraphs.en: Because fewer brokers are available, experts advise shoppers to make appointments early rather than waiting until the deadline. In addition, average insurance premiums are projected to rise by 15 percent, following a 26 percent increase the previous year. Although most buyers are still eligible for income-based subsidies, these financial aids are less generous than before. Therefore, analysts urge consumers to compare different plans online instead of letting their existing policies renew automatically.
paragraphs.zh: 由於可提供服務的經紀人變少，專家建議購買者提早預約，而不是等到截止期限。此外，繼前一年上漲百分之二十六之後，平均保險費預計還會再上漲百分之十五。儘管大多數買家仍有資格獲得依所得計算的補助，但這些財務援助比以往更少。因此，分析師強烈建議消費者在網路上比較不同的方案，而不是讓現有的保單自動續約。

grammar.point: 被動語態 (Passive Voice)
grammar.explain: 此處使用「be 動詞 is + 過去分詞 expected」，表示整體投保人數「被預期」將會減少。
grammar.example: Overall enrollment is expected to decline, largely because federal enhanced financial aid ended in late 2025.

grammar.explain: 關係代名詞 who 在子句中擔任主詞，指涉先行詞 new brokers，用來修飾其資格條件。

lessons.title: University staff warned of 'difficult decisions' ahead over finances
lessons.title_zh: 大學教職員因財務狀況收到未來面臨「艱難決定」之警告

paragraphs.en: Staff at Queen's University Belfast (QUB) have received a warning about tough choices ahead as the institution faces serious financial problems. In a message sent to employees, Vice-Chancellor Professor Sir Ian Greer explained that the university suffered a deficit of around £12.5 million during the previous financial year. This difficult situation arose mainly after government funding from the Northern Ireland Executive was significantly reduced for 2025/26.
paragraphs.zh: 貝爾法斯特女王大學（QUB）的教職員收到警告，由於該校正面臨嚴重的財務問題，未來將面臨艱難的抉擇。校長伊恩·格里爾教授（Professor Sir Ian Greer）在發給員工的訊息中解釋，學校在上一財政年度出現了約1,250萬英鎊的赤字。這種困境主要是在北愛爾蘭行政院大幅削減2025/26年度的政府補助之後出現的。

paragraphs.en: At the same time, university earnings have dropped. Greer noted that a decline in tuition fees, along with government budget cuts, forced the school to control costs. Stricter visa rules for international students entering the United Kingdom caused international student fee revenue to fall from over £60 million in 2024 to about £55 million in 2025. Furthermore, student recruitment income is projected to end up approximately £7 million below its original target.
paragraphs.zh: 與此同時，大學的收入也出現下滑。格里爾指出，學費收入下降加上政府預算削減，迫使學校必須控制成本。針對進入英國的國際學生所實施的更嚴格簽證規定，導致國際學生的學費收入從2024年的超過6,000萬英鎊，下降到2025年的約5,500萬英鎊。此外，學生招募收入預計將比原定目標短少約700萬英鎊。

paragraphs.en: Government rules have also limited student numbers. Due to an official cap decided by the Department for the Economy, the university had to reject around 500 local applicants who met the grade requirements. To deal with these pressures, the management board intends to identify roughly £10 million in savings. Consequently, campus parking fees for staff are rising, while agreed pay deals, childcare costs, and sports center fees are being reviewed and could increase.
paragraphs.zh: 政府規定也限制了學生人數。由於經濟部所制定的官方名額上限，該校不得不拒絕約500名達到成績標準的在地申請者。為了因應這些壓力，管理委員會打算找出約1,000萬英鎊的節省開銷方案。因此，校園內的教職員停車費正在調漲，而原本已同意的薪資待遇、托兒服務費用和體育中心費用也正在重新評估且可能會提高。

paragraphs.en: Despite these financial cutbacks, construction will continue on a new visitor and heritage center located in the Quad. A university spokesperson explained that such investments aim to create income and provide teaching space to support future growth. Greer emphasized that despite upcoming changes, "the student experience must remain central to our decisions" as the school seeks long-term stability.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管面臨這些財務緊縮，位於方庭（Quad）的一座新訪客與傳承中心工程仍將繼續進行。大學發言人解釋，這類投資旨在創造收入並提供教學空間以支持未來的成長。格里爾強調，儘管即將進行各項變動，但當學校尋求長期穩定之際，「學生體驗必須維持在我們決策的核心地位」。

lessons.title: Oil tank vandalism results in waterfowl park 'nightmare'
lessons.title_zh: 油槽遭蓄意破壞導致水禽公園面臨「惡夢」

paragraphs.en: A popular waterfowl park in County Antrim has been forced to close after an act of vandalism led to a deadly oil spill. The incident occurred when someone damaged a nearby home heating oil tank, releasing kerosene into the pond at Broughshane Waterfowl Park. Gary Hayward, the chairman of the park's trust, described the tragedy as a "nightmare" that has already caused the deaths of 13 birds.
paragraphs.zh: 安特里姆郡（County Antrim）一座受歡迎的水禽公園在經歷一起導致致命漏油的蓄意破壞行為後，被迫暫時關閉。這起事件發生在有人破壞了附近一個家用暖氣油槽，將煤油排放進布拉夫謝恩水禽公園（Broughshane Waterfowl Park）的池塘中。該公園信託基金會主席蓋瑞．海沃德（Gary Hayward）形容這場悲劇是一場「惡夢」，目前已經造成13隻鳥類死亡。

paragraphs.en: The park is home to 120 captive collection birds as well as wild birds. A volunteer first noticed the strong smell of fuel and discovered black swans completely covered in oil on a Thursday morning. In response, more than 20 birds, including swans, geese, and ducks, were immediately transported to the headquarters of the USPCA for urgent specialist treatment.
paragraphs.zh: 該公園除了野生鳥類外，還飼養了120隻園方收藏的鳥類。一名志工在星期四早晨首次聞到濃烈的燃油味，並發現黑天鵝全身覆蓋著油污。作為因應，包括天鵝、鵝和鴨子在內的20多隻鳥類被立刻送往USPCA（阿爾斯特防止虐待動物協會）總部接受緊急專業治療。

paragraphs.en: Staff at the USPCA have been working tirelessly to wash the affected animals and give them charcoal to absorb dangerous toxins they may have swallowed. Siobhan Hawthorn, a wildlife supervisor at the animal welfare group, explained that caring for the birds has placed heavy emotional stress on the team. She noted that birds often hide symptoms of sickness, making it difficult to know if they will survive after ingesting poisonous oil.
paragraphs.zh: USPCA的工作人員一直不知疲倦地工作，替受影響的動物清洗身體，並給予活性碳以吸收牠們可能吞下的危險毒素。該動物福利團體的野生動物主管希歐班．霍桑（Siobhan Hawthorn）解釋，照顧這些鳥類給團隊帶來了沉重的情緒壓力。她指出，鳥類通常很會隱藏生病的症狀，因此很難知道牠們在吞下有毒燃油後是否能存活下來。

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, the Northern Ireland Environment Agency (NIEA) was alerted on Thursday 22 October. Inspectors quickly deployed absorbent booms and other countermeasures to clean the polluted waterway. Although the pond's condition has improved, the non-native birds cannot return until the area is fully cleaned. Local police have appealed for anyone with information about the vandalism to come forward.
paragraphs.zh: 與此同時，北愛爾蘭環境署（NIEA）在10月22日星期四接獲通報。稽查人員迅速部署了吸油柵欄與其他應變措施來清理受污染的水道。雖然池塘的狀況已經大幅改善，但在該區域被徹底清潔乾淨之前，這些非本土鳥類仍無法返回。當地警方已呼籲任何掌握破壞事件資訊的人主動提供線索。

phrases.zh: 挺身而出；主動提供資訊

lessons.title: These firms you've never heard of are feeding fears the AI bubble could burst
lessons.title_zh: 這些你從未聽過的公司正在加劇人們對人工智慧泡沫可能破裂的擔憂

paragraphs.en: A lesser-known part of the artificial intelligence (AI) industry is now facing intense examination from investors. Specialized data centre companies, known as "neocloud" firms, operate large facilities packed with expensive computer chips. These companies, including CoreWeave and Nebius, rent computing power to major tech players such as OpenAI and Meta. However, many people in Silicon Valley are now questioning whether these businesses can survive financially.
paragraphs.zh: 人工智慧（AI）產業中一個較不為人知的領域，如今正面臨投資人嚴格的檢視。被稱為「新雲端」（neocloud）公司的專門資料中心企業，營運著裝滿昂貴電腦晶片的大型設施。這些包括 CoreWeave 和 Nebius 在內的公司，將運算能力出租給 OpenAI 和 Meta 等科技巨頭。然而，矽谷許多人現在開始質疑這些企業在財務上是否能夠生存。

paragraphs.en: To fund their expensive hardware, neocloud firms typically sign long-term leasing contracts with major clients and borrow huge amounts of money using the hardware and contracts as collateral. For instance, CoreWeave has accumulated over thirty-five billion dollars in debt. Lenders often agree to these loans because they trust the creditworthiness of giant customers like Microsoft. Yet, research firms like Gartner predict that most neocloud companies will stop operating independently by 2030.
paragraphs.zh: 為了替昂貴的硬體籌措資金，新雲端公司通常會與主要客戶簽訂長期租賃合約，並以硬體和合約作為抵押品借入巨額資金。例如，CoreWeave 已經累積了超過三百五十億美元的債務。放款機構通常願意批准這些貸款，是因為他們信任微軟（Microsoft）等巨頭客戶的信譽。然而，像顧能（Gartner）這樣的研究機構預測，大多數新雲端公司將在 2030 年前停止獨立運作。

paragraphs.en: Recently, investor confidence has dropped. Shares in several firms, including CoreWeave, Nebius, and Applied Digital, have lost about a quarter of their value over the past month. Interestingly, several of these businesses originally began as cryptocurrency mining operations before shifting to AI in 2022. Although CoreWeave CEO Mike Intrator stated that the market is acting "irrationally," debt investors continue to demand higher returns.
paragraphs.zh: 最近，投資人的信心有所下滑。在過去一個月裡，包括 CoreWeave、Nebius 和 Applied Digital 在內的數家公司股價下跌了約四分之一。有趣的是，其中幾家企業最初是從事加密貨幣挖礦業務，直到 2022 年才轉向人工智慧領域。儘管 CoreWeave 執行長麥克．因特拉托（Mike Intrator）表示市場表現得很「不理性」，但債券投資人仍持續要求更高的回報。

paragraphs.en: The future of these companies heavily depends on the spending plans of tech giants. When Microsoft and Google recently projected lower AI spending, neocloud shares fell sharply. In addition, high interest rates make borrowing more expensive, and problems like power shortages have caused cancelled deals. If the AI bubble bursts, experts warn that many smaller neocloud providers may struggle to survive.
paragraphs.zh: 這些公司的未來在很大程度上取決於科技巨頭的支出計畫。當微軟和 Google 最近預測人工智慧支出將減少時，新雲端公司的股價大幅下跌。此外，高利率使借貸成本變得更加昂貴，而電力短缺等問題也導致合約遭到取消。如果人工智慧泡沫破裂，專家警告許多較小的新雲端供應商可能會難以生存。

grammar.point: 過去分詞片語修飾名詞 (Past Participle Phrase)
grammar.explain: 過去分詞片語 packed with... 作為後置修飾語，修飾前面的名詞 facilities，表示被裝滿的狀態。
grammar.example: Specialized data centre companies, known as "neocloud" firms, operate large facilities packed with expensive computer chips.
grammar.focus: packed with expensive computer chips

grammar.point: 現在完成式 (Present Perfect Tense)
grammar.explain: 由 has 加上過去分詞 accumulated 構成，表示從過去一段時間持續累積到現在的動作與狀態。
grammar.example: For instance, CoreWeave has accumulated over thirty-five billion dollars in debt.
grammar.focus: has accumulated

grammar.point: that 引導的名詞子句 (Noun Clause with that)
grammar.explain: 連接詞 that 引導完整的子句，作為主要動詞 predict 的受詞。
grammar.example: Yet, research firms like Gartner predict that most neocloud companies will stop operating independently by 2030.
